title: The Milk Bottle for the Night Step

moral: Noticing who is tired is already a gentle skill.
summary: At a library return desk and the rainy steps, a milk bottle that belonged on the night step is awkward for one person. Lior notices Mr. Ade struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
